title: A hybrid plasma-electro-membrane triple intensified system over PdNPs/Fe–N–C for ammonium fertilizer synthesis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8849-8859
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01513H, Paper
Cheng Wang, Chang Yu, Bingzhi Qian, Yongwen Ren, Rulong Ma, Yue Chu, Jieshan Qiu
A hybrid system (consisting of a pNOR system, a NO2– electroreduction system powered by PdNPs/Fe–N–C, and a membrane separation system) converts air to ammonium fertilizer, achieving a high ammonium sulfate yield of 685.8 mg h−1.
